tools.name: add
tools.description: Add two numbers together and return their sum.

tools.name: secret_function
tools.description: Computes ((a + b) raised to the power of a), then floor-divides the result by b. Both a and b should be integers, and b must not be zero.

a.description: The base offset and exponent used in the calculation.

b.description: The divisor for the final floor division. Must not be zero.

tools.name: is_fibonacci_number
tools.description: Determines whether a given integer is a Fibonacci number, using the identity that n is a Fibonacci number if and only if 5n^2 + 4 or 5n^2 - 4 is a perfect square.

a.description: The integer to test for membership in the Fibonacci sequence.

tools.name: glaze
tools.description: Returns a short, compliment about MCP. Takes no input.
